import re

def parse(lines):
    skip = []
    ifl = []
    ifr = []
    adl = []
    adr = []
    kvl = []
    kv = {}
    cur = None
    router = ''
    rtitle = re.compile(r'^\s*Interface Table\s*\((?:Router|Service):\s*(?P<router>[^)]+?)\s*\)')
    rif = re.compile(r'^(?P<name>\S+)\s+(?P<adm>\S+)\s+(?P<opr>\S+)\s+(?P<mode>\S+)(?:\s+(?P<port>\S+))?\s*$')
    rad = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<ip>\S+)(?:\s+(?P<pfx>\S+))?\s*$')
    rkv = re.compile(r'^(?P<k>[A-Za-z][\w -]*?)\s+:\s+(?P<v>\S.*?)\s*$')
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        s = l.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        m = rtitle.match(l)
        if m:
            router = m.group('router')
            cur = None
            ifl.append(i)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^[=\-]{10,}$', s) or re.match(r'^\S+#', s) or s.startswith('Interface Table') or s.startswith('Interface-Name') or re.match(r'^IP-Address\s+PfxState', s):
            skip.append(i)
            continue
        m = rkv.match(l)
        if m and not l.startswith(' '):
            kv[m.group('k').strip()] = m.group('v')
            kvl.append(i)
            continue
        if l.startswith(' '):
            m = rad.match(l)
            if m and cur is not None:
                adl.append(i)
                if m.group('ip') != '-':
                    adr.append({'Router': router, 'Interface-Name': cur, 'IP-Address': m.group('ip'), 'PfxState': m.group('pfx') or ''})
            continue
        m = rif.match(l)
        if m:
            cur = m.group('name')
            ifl.append(i)
            ifr.append({'Router': router, 'Interface-Name': cur, 'Adm': m.group('adm'), 'Opr(v4/v6)': m.group('opr'), 'Mode': m.group('mode'), 'Port/SapId': m.group('port') or ''})
    blocks = [{'name': 'interfaces', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ifl, 'records': ifr},
              {'name': 'addresses', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': adl, 'records': adr}]
    if kv:
        blocks.append({'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': kvl, 'records': [kv]})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}

fixes: Line 3 'Interface Table (Router: Base)' names the router instance (Base) that every interface and address row belongs to, but the template sets it aside as decoration. Capture the router name from that title with a pattern like `Interface Table \(Router: (?P<router>[^)]+)\)`. Carry it down as a `Router` column on both the interfaces rows and the addresses rows, and reset it at each new 'Interface Table' title so a capture covering several routers (Base plus VPRNs) keeps their rows apart. The parser is already format 2. Move line 3 from skip into the lines the interfaces block reads.
